verdict.rationale: A probe found an OpenAPI spec published on CodeRabbit's own docs domain (docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json), and a community commenter mentions calling CodeRabbit's API to generate a patch. Together these indicate a documented public API exists, but nothing in the pack shows what the API covers or whether it can drive core actions like triggering reviews. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the API's endpoints and scope, evidence that it can drive reviews and fixes programmatically, auth/key documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
